info.description:
Cloud Aurora — Global Streaming Subtitles is a lightweight universal subtitle styling module designed to bring the soft, dreamy Cloud Aurora aesthetic to streaming platforms across the web.

It replaces the default subtitle appearance with clean Netflix Sans typography, transparent backgrounds, and carefully balanced shadows for improved readability without disrupting the original video player layout.

Designed for compatibility with YouTube, Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video, native HTML5/WebVTT captions, Shaka Player, Video.js, Plyr, Bitmovin, and other compatible streaming players.

☁️Features☁️:

☁️ Pastel Aurora aesthetic.  

✦ Netflix Sans typography.
  
☁️ No intrusive subtitle background boxes. 

✦ Clean, readable caption shadows.  

☁️ Preserves subtitle size and positioning.  

✦ Designed as a global Stylish module.
info.additionalInfo:
Cloud Aurora — Global Streaming Subtitles v1.0

Initial public release of the standalone Cloud Aurora subtitle system.

This module was originally developed as part of the Cloud Aurora YouTube visual theme and has now been separated into a global streaming component.

Included in v1.0:

• Netflix Sans subtitle typography  
• Transparent caption backgrounds  
• Cloud Aurora readability shadow system  
• Native HTML5 / WebVTT support  
• YouTube caption support  
• Netflix caption support  
• Disney+ subtitle renderer support  
• Amazon Prime Video caption support  
• Shaka Player support  
• Video.js support  
• Plyr support  
• Bitmovin Player support  
• YouTube active CC indicator styling  

The module intentionally does not override subtitle size, line height, alignment, or screen position. These remain controlled by each streaming service and the user's accessibility preferences.

Broad selectors such as [class*="subtitle"] and [class*="caption"] are intentionally avoided to prevent the style from affecting unrelated website text.

Part of the Cloud Aurora visual ecosystem. ☁️?
